edges.notes: reload(): requestJson(chatUrls.previewUrl(chatId)); chatUrls.previewUrl builds `/api/chats/${id}/preview-url` (chat-api.ts line 24). requestJson(url, init) (lib/http-client.ts) is fetch(url, …) on the path it is given, so the label is at this requestJson call; no init, so GET
resume(): fetch(chatUrls.resume(chatId), { method: "POST", signal }), handed to runExternalStream as a request function; chatUrls.resume is `/api/chats/${id}/resume`
resolveTask(): fetch(chatUrls.resolve(chatId), { method: "POST", … }); chatUrls.resolve is `/api/chats/${id}/resolve`

fetchMessagesPage(): requestJson(`${chatUrls.messages(chatId)}?${params}`, {}); query dropped; empty init, so GET. The path is fixed here (the helper takes an id, not a path), so the label is at this requestJson call
stopMessage(): requestJson(chatUrls.stop(chatId, messageId), { method: "POST" })
restoreMessage(): requestJson(chatUrls.restore(chatId), { method: "POST", json })

fetchFiles(): requestJson(chatUrls.files(chatId), {}). code-panel.tsx's useSWR([chatUrls.files(chatId), revision], () => fetchFiles(chatId)) passes a fetcher that ignores its key and calls this helper, which fixes the path itself, so the label is here, not at the useSWR call
updateFiles(): requestJson(chatUrls.files(chatId), { method: "PATCH", json })
deployChat(): requestJson(chatUrls.deploy(chatId), { method: "POST" })
createVercelProject(): requestJson(chatUrls.project(chatId), { method: "POST" })
duplicateChat(): requestJson(chatUrls.duplicate(chatId), { method: "POST", json: {} }); also re-exported by chats/lib/chat-actions-api.ts
migrateChat(): requestJson(chatUrls.migrate(chatId), { method: "POST" })

importChat(source): requestJson(`/api/chats/import/${kind}`, { method: "POST" }), kind from the ImportSource union "repo" | "zip" | "files"; import-menu.tsx passes all three as literals (kind: "files" at line 147), so one label per route (ADR-0041). The literal import segment wins over [chatId] in Next's routing
importChat(source) with kind: "repo" (import-menu.tsx line 167); see the files label
importChat(source) with kind: "zip" (import-menu.tsx line 127); see the files label
fetchConnectStatus(): requestJson(chatUrls.connectStatus(chatId, requestId), {}); the builder appends ?requestId=…, query dropped

useSWR(isSignedIn ? USER_CHATS_CACHE_KEY : null) with no fetcher of its own: SWR calls the global fetcher from SWRConfig (components/providers/swr-provider.tsx line 11, requestJson(url)) with the key, so the label is at this useSWR call; USER_CHATS_CACHE_KEY = chatUrls.list = "/api/chats". Conditional key, still one label. The mutate(USER_CHATS_CACHE_KEY) revalidations elsewhere aren't labeled
renameChat(): requestJson(chatUrls.chat(chatId), { method: "PATCH", json: { title } }); chatUrls.chat is `/api/chats/${id}`
deleteChat(): requestJson(chatUrls.chat(chatId), { method: "DELETE" })
updateChatVisibility(): requestJson(chatUrls.chat(chatId), { method: "PATCH", json: { privacy } })

fetchCredits = () => requestJson(CREDITS_URL, {}), CREDITS_URL = "/api/user/credits". credits-summary.tsx's useSWR(CREDITS_URL, fetchCredits) hands SWR a fetcher that ignores the key and fixes the path itself, so the label is here, not at the useSWR call

fetchV0ApiKeyStatus(): requestJson(V0_KEY_ENDPOINT), "/api/user/v0-key"; no init, so GET. Reached from use-v0-api-key-form.ts's useSWR(isOpen ? "v0-api-key-status" : null, fetchV0ApiKeyStatus), whose key is a cache name, not a URL, and whose fetcher fixes the path itself
saveV0ApiKey(): requestJson(V0_KEY_ENDPOINT, { method: "PUT", json })
deleteV0ApiKey(): requestJson(V0_KEY_ENDPOINT, { method: "DELETE" })

getLegacyChat(): requestV1(apiKey, `/chats/${chatId}`). requestV1(apiKey, path) (server/v0/legacy-api.ts) is fetch(`${LEGACY_V0_API_URL}${path}`) with no method, LEGACY_V0_API_URL the literal "https://api.v0.dev/v1" (server/env.ts): v0's API, an external host
migrateLegacyChat(): requestV1(apiKey, `/chats/${legacyChatId}`) to https://api.v0.dev/v1, external
migrateLegacyChat(): requestV1(apiKey, `/chats/${legacyChatId}/versions/${versionId}/download?…`) to https://api.v0.dev/v1, external
getPlan(): requestV1(apiKey, "/user/plan") to https://api.v0.dev/v1, external; the .json() on the same line is not a request
